text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi opposition leader in London says: U.S. aggression against Iraq is an aggression against Arabs and Moslems.
- Iraq is represented in the World Health Organisation conference which starts in Pakistan on Sunday.
- Palestinian leader and Egyptian president say Washington summit is an election festival for U.S. President (Bill Clinton).
(The above stories were carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Former French minister of external trade says Paris is distancing itself from the U.S. policy toward Iraq.
- Hungary is ready to supply Iraq with industrial goods.
